headline: Trane Technologies Raises Full-Year Forecast After Strong Second-Quarter Performance
summary: Trane Technologies plc (NYSE:TT) reported better-than-expected second-quarter earnings on Thursday and lifted its full-year guidance after continued demand for its energy-efficient climate solutions drove double-digit revenue growth. The stronger outlook was welcomed by investors, sending the company’s shares up 6.

headline: Trane Technologies’s (NYSE:TT) Q2 CY2026: Beats On Revenue, Stock Soars
summary: HVAC company Trane (NYSE:TT) beat Wall Street’s revenue expectations in Q2 CY2026, with sales up 10.6% year on year to $6.35 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $4.31 per share was 1.1% above analysts’ consensus estimates.

headline: Trane Technologies Reports Strong Second Quarter Results; Raises Full-Year Revenue and EPS Guidance
summary: SWORDS, Ireland, July 30, 2026--Trane Technologies plc (NYSE:TT), a global climate innovator, today reported diluted earnings per share (EPS) from continuing operations of $4.20 for the second quarter of 2026. Adjusted continuing EPS was $4.31, up 11 percent.
